description: Find open-source AI projects by what they do, e.g. 'run chat models offline' or 'transcribe audio'. Searches both shelves unless 'shelf' is given: 'ai' (AI tools) or 'ai-integrated' (everyday software that AI assistants can use, e.g. a notes app with an MCP server). Optionally narrow by category or by whether it can be used without writing code. Returns short summaries, best matches first.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, max 25).

query.description: Words describing what you're looking for.

shelf.description: 'ai' = AI tools, 'ai-integrated' = software that works with AI. Leave out to search both.

useWithoutCoding.description: 'yes' = no coding needed, 'some-setup' = usable with some setup, 'developers' = needs a developer.

name: search_projects
title: Search AI projects
